holderPosition.legalForm: Undocumented: a platform-issued Token-2022 token asserted to be backed 1:1 by a share or metal held through an unnamed regulated custodian; no terms, prospectus or note conditions were ever published in readable form, and no issuing entity or governing law is named
holderPosition.says: When the platform ran, a KYC-verified account holder could mint against USDC and redeem through the platform for USDC; holding the token alone never entitled the bearer to the underlying. Since the wind-down of 23-24 February 2026 there is no redemption right, no process and no market, and the nature, ranking and enforceability of the claim, and the party it runs against, are unknown.

Outstanding supply TSLAr 1,238.996656657, NVDAr 1,190.998328212 and GLDr 138.512544270 (9 decimals); no burn retired the programme.

outside.says: Originally KYC- or KYB-verified platform account holders, through the platform, for USDC; nothing replaced that after the wind-down. No terms survive to say what a holder may enforce.
Unknown: no readable source states a governing law, forum or dispute clause.

Minting was priced at the platform's own mark from traditional exchanges; the exit book used a stale Friday close; third-party valuations disagree by more than two orders of magnitude (CoinGecko ~$138.9M, RWA.xyz $1.87M, DefiLlama $479,846).

verdict.summary: Not 'not-a-token': the mints, about $2M of supply across about 3,600 holders and the 2-of-3 vault that controls them are still live, so there is a token to restate. But the core cannot be said, because no terms were ever published, no issuer, custodian, auditor or licensor is named, and the only surviving statements are the operator's own unsupported 1:1 claims, now reported by the press. v3 can record the wind-down, the exit-liquidity event and the absence of everything else, which is the honest record of this programme.
